description: The SKOS integrity rule: broader on a cluster file is nesting, exported as parent skos:member child. skos:broader has domain and range skos:Concept and skos:Collection is disjoint with skos:Concept, so emitting skos:broader on a Cluster would entail a contradiction and fail every SKOS validator. The graph term: every line is a quad whose fourth term is the Bundle IRI `<https://example.org/>` (AGSC-04-15 as amended at rc.6, PY2-01), so each line of graph-0002 is restated here with ` <https://example.org/>` inserted before its terminating ` .`; nothing else moves, and because the same suffix is added to every line the byte order of the lines is unchanged.
note: added 2026-09-23 at rc.6 (EXT-2b, PY2-01); derived by hand from AGSC-04-15 as amended and AGSC-05-03, superseding graph-0002
